description: A vulnerability in NGINX occurs when the listen directive is used with the ssl parameter in the http block with TLSv1.3 enabled. An attacker can send a specially crafted TLS connection that causes an infinite loop in the worker process while reading the HTTP request body. This leads to the worker process ceasing to accept or process connections, resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS). This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
